name: Somraj Mukherjee
about: I'm Somraj — a software engineer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise web apps with React, Vue, Node.js and Spring Boot.
Currently an Associate Director at UBS, modernising internal case-management and reporting tools.
I enjoy open source, shipping polished UIs, and writing about what I learn on the blog.
Open to frontend roles in Berlin and across Europe, and eligible for the EU Blue Card.

experience.title: Associate Director
points: Rebuilt report exports as async background jobs with status tracking and scheduled runs. 12-sheet Excel reports of 15,000+ rows that used to time out now download 85% faster.
Shipped 20+ case-management workflow features, including approvals, assessments, due dates and team permissions, with 80% code coverage from automated tests.
Helped migrate a legacy system to React and Spring Boot, building the backend APIs with shared data models and database migrations.
Made audit trails easier to read and filter through 8 audit and admin-data improvements, and added test, lint and CI checks across 4 repositories.

experience.title: Software Engineer
points: Integrated Securly Pass with Securly Visitor, streamlining visitor management for 5,000+ schools and cutting manual check-in time by 30%.
Improved stability of the Securly Pass Dashboard and mobile app, cutting reported dashboard bugs by 90% and keeping the app above 99% crash-free.
Migrated legacy frontend system to a Vite-based build setup, reducing build time from 40 minutes to under 10 minutes, significantly boosting developer productivity.

experience.title: Software Developer
points: Developed a Home Page for Premium users, giving them one hub to track their progress and lifting engagement with premium services by 25%.
Worked on revamp of Application and Document Manager, involving Counsellors and Premium Users. This reduced TAT of Counsellor Tasks by 30%
Performed Integration with Third Party services for better assistance to Premium Users

experience.title: Software Engineer
points: Developed responsive and dynamic user forms, cutting form load times by 20%.
Built a library of reusable components and utility functions, cutting development effort for new features by about 30%.
Conducted POC assessments to evaluate feasibility of advanced payment solutions.

experience.title: Open Source Contributor
points: Collaborated with cross-functional teams, mentors, and fellow contributors to seamlessly integrate new UI components.
Enhanced Redux store with additional modules for state management.
Developed Ovulation Calculator and Calendar app, offering a seamless and intuitive experience to track fertility and menstrual cycles.
Implemented Date Picker functionality and refactored other UI elements
